There are 4 upgraded tiers of Terror Armor: '''Hot''', '''Burning''', '''Fiery''', and '''Infernal''', which can all be obtained by prestiging the previous tier. == Obtaining == Basic Tier '''Terror Armor''' Pieces can be obtained from [[Kuudra#Reward Chests|Paid Reward Chests]] at the end of a [[Kuudra]] fight. ;Piece Drop Chances *Basic Tier: {{Green|4.31%}} *Hot Tier: {{Green|4.2%}} *Burning Tier: {{Green|4.05%}} *Fiery Tier: {{Green|3.91%}} *Infernal Tier: {{Green|4.08%}} Higher tiers of '''Terror Armor''' can be obtained by prestiging the previous tier at a blacksmith ({{NPCSprite|Malik}}, {{NPCSprite|Igor}}, {{NPCSprite|Alwin}}, or [[The Hex]]), which can be done if it has 10 [[Star Upgrades|Stars]] applied to it. When hitting enemies with arrows, 1 stack of Hydra Strike is gained, but they cannot be gained more than once every 0.2s. Upon reaching 10 stacks, two additional arrows are fired. These arrows inherit most of the properties of the bow it was fired at; for example, a Juju Shortbow's Hydra Strike arrows can damage endermen and cause an AOE effect that hits up to 3 mobs upon striking an enemy. These arrows gain extra damage based on how many pieces of '''Terror Armor''' are worn and what tier they are: {| class="wikitable" !Terror !Infernal !Fiery !Burning !Hot !Basic |- !4/4 | +15% | +12.75% | +10.5% | +8.25% | +6% |- !3/4 | +10% | +8.5% | +7% | +5.5% | +4% |- !2/4 | +5% | +4.25% | +3.5% | +2.75% | +2% |- |} The damage of the extra arrows increase based on the lowest tier of '''Terror Armor''' being worn. 10 Heavy Pearl; 100 Kuudra Teeth }} == Skins == {{Item Skins|Terror Helmet}} == Trivia == * The Tiered Bonus interferes with the enchantment [[Enchantments|Overload]], causing the 10%-50% damage bonus to not apply when at max tier and shooting 3 arrows. *The Tiered Bonus interferes with the [[Spirit Bow]], causing the 2% damage bonus for every 1% of your missing health to undead monsters to not apply when at max tier and shooting 3 arrows. *The Tiered Bonus interferes with all types of special arrows, causing them to not work. *The Tiered Bonus interferes with [[Spirit Bow (Thorn)]], causing it to not be able to damage thorn when at max tier and shooting 3 arrows *It has been observed by some community members that the usage of the word “Stacks” and how they function could be a potential reference to the Risk of Rain series.{{Confirm}} * A total of {{Item|Crimson Essence|amount=141005}}, {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=45}}, {{Item|Kuudra Teeth|amount=160}}, and {{Coins|44740000}} are required for one Infernal tier piece, costing {{BZC|*141005 Crimson Essence *45 Heavy Pearl *160 Kuudra Teeth|44740000}}. **A total of {{Item|Crimson Essence|amount=1793505}}, {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=97}}, and {{Coins|139175000}} are needed from scratch for a single Infernal piece with 15 [[Stars]]. An Infernal Terror Helmet additionally requires {{Item|Kuudra Teeth|amount=440}}, costing {{BZC|*1793505 Crimson Essence *97 Heavy Pearl *440 Kuudra Teeth|139175000}}, while an Infernal Terror Chestplate, Leggings, or Boots requires {{Item|Kuudra Teeth|amount=460}}, costing {{BZC|*1793505 Crimson Essence *97 Heavy Pearl *460 Kuudra Teeth|139175000}}. == Gallery == Chaos Terror Arrow Trail Render.png|Arrow trails with the [[Chaos Terror Helmet Skin]] applied == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/February 22|link=none|[[File:Terror Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Terror Armor'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Terror Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Terror Armor'''.}} {{History|0.19.5|Lowered {{skl|combat}} requirement from 24 to 22.}} {{History|0.20.9|Revamped {{AN|Hydra Strike}}. |'''Terror Armor''' no longer becomes {{Soulbound|Co-op}} when starred or prestiged. |Adjusted requirements to use each tier of '''Terror Armor''' from {{Skill|Combat|22}} across the board to: * Base: {{Skill|Combat|22}} and [[Kuudra]] Basic Tier Completion * Hot: {{Skill|Combat|27}} and [[Kuudra]] Hot Tier Completion * Burning: {{Skill|Combat|32}} and [[Kuudra]] Burning Tier Completion * Fiery: {{Skill|Combat|37}} and [[Kuudra]] Fiery Tier Completion * Infernal: {{Skill|Combat|42}} and [[Kuudra]] Infernal Tier Completion}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Armors}} {{Nav/Kuudra}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}
